news_items.headline: Claude Can Now Build Its Own Harness... For Every Task
news_items.summary:
[Prompt Engineering · 17K views] In this video I explain why using one coding harness (like Claude Code/Codex) for all knowledge work breaks down as the context window fills, leading to agentic laziness, self-preferential bias, and goal drift. I show how dynamic workflows solve this by splitting work into clean contexts via a JavaScript workflow that can spawn agents, run them in parallel, and use pipelines, choose models, resume after interruption, and optionally isolate work trees.

Anthropic Blogpost: https://claude.com/blog
